items.source: NOTE: Since Spring 2.5, the preferred way to register bean definitions programmatically is the GenericBeanDefinition class, which allows to dynamically define parent dependencies through the GenericBeanDefinition.setParentName(String) method. This effectively supersedes the ChildBeanDefinition class for most use cases.
items.translation: 注意：自 Spring 2.5 以来，程序化注册 Bean 定义的首选方式是使用GenericBeanDefinition类，该类的GenericBeanDefinition.setParentName(String)方法允许动态定义父级依赖。这在大多数使用场景中实际上已取代了 ChildBeanDefinition 类。

items.source: A child bean definition will inherit constructor argument values, property values and method overrides from the parent, with the option to add new values. If init method, destroy method and/or static factory method are specified, they will override the corresponding parent settings. The remaining settings will always be taken from the child definition: depends on, autowire mode, dependency check, singleton, lazy init.
items.translation: 子 Bean 定义将继承父类的构造函数参数值、属性值和覆盖方法，并可选择添加新值。如果指定了初始化方法、销毁方法和/或静态工厂方法，它们将覆盖相应的父类设置。其余设置（depends-on、autowire mode、dependency check、singleton、lazy init）将始终取自子定义。
